get_model_by_builder: get a model from the model zoo factory by passing a builder name and optional pretrained flag
register_model_builder: register a new model builder function with the MODEL_ZOO_FACTORY registry using a decorator
list_registered_builders: list all registered model builder names in the MODEL_ZOO_FACTORY registry using get_names
check_builder_exists: check if a model builder name is already registered in the MODEL_ZOO_FACTORY registry
review_MODEL_ZOO_FACTORY: review the MODEL_ZOO_FACTORY registry and get_model function to understand the model creation pattern
